import subprocess

# Test 2: research with cache=False on cyclic structure - should raise RecursionError
code = r'''
from boltons.iterutils import research

a = [1]
a.append(a)
try:
    result = research(a, query=lambda p, k, v: False, cache=False)
    print("FAIL: should have raised RecursionError, got:", result)
except RecursionError as e:
    print("PASS: RecursionError raised as expected")
'''
result = subprocess.run(['python', '-c', code], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=5)
print(result.stdout)
